title: Vibe Prompt Maker
summary: Builds an AI Prompt Maker: a one-page dark-theme form where you fill in fields and get clean plain ASCII text to paste into an AI prompt.
what_it_is: A Claude skill that makes a small web tool, the AI Prompt Maker, in the same locked Vibe Coding design as Swami's dashboards. The page has two parts: an **Input** form with editable fields, and a live **Output** panel that shows the fields as plain text.

Swami names the fields and their defaults (or reuses his standard set: subject, topic, issue, date, student, helper, AI used, websites, and content). Claude fills them into a prebuilt template, sets the header text, and publishes the page. All the interaction logic is already built into the template, so Claude never rewrites it.
why: Pasting a situation into an AI chat works best when it is complete, tidy, and plain text. A fill-in form keeps every case (a student, a client, someone Swami is helping) in the same shape, and the plain ASCII output pastes cleanly into any AI.

what_it_does.text: One row per field: an editable field name (the mono cyan box) joined to its value. Long text gets a big text box and lists get one box per entry.
Shows the text as you type, as `key: value` lines, lists as indented `- ` items, and long text as a block. Empty fields are left out.
Converts smart quotes, dashes, ellipses, accents, and symbols to plain characters, so the text pastes cleanly anywhere.
Rename a field, delete it with ✕, add one with **+ Add field**, and drag the ⠿ handle to reorder.
The `[ ]` / `[≣]` toggle switches a field between one value and a list, splitting or joining on commas.
Copies the text to the clipboard, or saves it as a .txt file named after the subject field, from the toolbar or the Output panel.
One click restores the default fields, with a 4-second Undo; no pop-up confirmations, because the artifact frame blocks them.
Ships with subject, topic, issue, date (today), student/client/other, teacher/consultant/helper (Swami), AI used, websites (a list), and content/text (long text).
Same palette, fonts, kicker, and footer as vibe-dashboard; both sections start collapsed.

triggers: "Make me an AI prompt maker" / "a prompt builder"
"I need an input sheet for a client case that I can paste into an AI"
"Make a prompt maker with these fields: …"

how_to_use.step: Ask for a prompt maker, and list the fields you want (or say to use the standard set). Mention any defaults, lists, or long-text fields.
Claude copies the template, fills in the field list and the header text, and keeps everything else as is.
Claude publishes it as a private artifact with the downloads permission, so the Download button works. Expect one approval prompt.
Open the page, expand **Input**, and type into the fields. Rename, add, delete, or reorder fields as needed.
Click **Copy text** and paste into your AI chat, or click **Download .txt** to save it.
Click **Reset to defaults** for a fresh form; click again within 4 seconds to undo.

how_to_use_windows.step: Building happens in Claude's workspace and the page runs in the browser, so the steps are the same on Windows.
Open the page in Edge, Chrome, or Firefox. Copy pastes with Ctrl+V.
On the published page, **Download .txt** asks where to save. If you open the .html file from disk instead, it saves to your Downloads folder (`C:\Users\<name>\Downloads`).
The text uses plain line endings; Notepad on Windows 10 (1809 or later) and Windows 11 shows them correctly.

capabilities.text: Works for any case you want to describe to an AI: students, clients, support requests, projects.
Fields can be renamed, added, removed, reordered, and switched between single and list while you work.
The output is plain ASCII, so it never brings odd characters into a prompt.
Saved as a .html file, it works from disk with a normal browser download.

limitations.text: Nothing is saved between visits; reloading the page brings back the defaults. Copy or download before closing.
Output is plain `key: value` text; there is no JSON or other format switch.
There is no way to load a saved .txt back into the form.
On the published page, Download needs the downloads permission; without it, use Copy.

gotchas.text: The form keeps no browser storage, by design. Reloading or closing the page loses what you typed.
The artifact frame blocks confirm and alert dialogs, so Reset uses the in-button Undo instead. Never add pop-ups back.
A published page can't start a download by itself. Without the downloads permission the button says to use Copy.
Characters with no plain equivalent (emoji, other scripts) become `?` in the output.
Both sections start collapsed; click **Input** to begin.
Switching a list back to a single value joins its entries with commas; switching again splits on commas.

requirements.text: Publishing needs Claude's artifacts, plus the downloads permission for the Download button.
Any current browser on macOS or on Windows 10 or 11.
Copy uses the browser clipboard; if the browser blocks it, the page falls back to an older copy method.

spoken._intro: This page is the skill sheet for the vibe prompt maker skill. It builds an AI prompt maker: a one page form where you fill in fields and get clean plain text, ready to paste into an AI.
